name: Userbrain
description: Explore your user test data, summarize feedback, and uncover actionable insights faster. Ask questions about tests, participants, tasks, and findings in plain language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Userbrain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Userbrain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.userbrain.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Userbrain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Userbrain provides these MCP tools: get_insights, get_tasks, get_test, get_videos, and list_tests.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Userbrain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Userbrain in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Userbrain requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Userbrain is developed by Userbrain GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
